item.title: Switch to TikTok Before Making

turns.text: I want a 6-second widescreen animation of a coffee cup on a rainy windowsill, steam curling up. Cosy illustrated look, no text or sound. Just tell me your plan before making it.
Actually make it for TikTok instead. Vertical, same idea and length. Go ahead and make it now.
